# PhotoCraft
> Free, open-source, in-browser Photoshop alternative built from scratch in pure Rust. Runs in modern browsers via WebGPU/WebAssembly and on native desktop.

## Summary
PhotoCraft is a professional raster graphics editor designed by the ArtCraft project as a clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop. It provides 1:1 workflow and shortcut parity (Cmd/Ctrl+J, Cmd/Ctrl+T, etc.), full multi-layer PSD/PSB file fidelity, 52 native tools, 16 adjustment layers, and real ICC color management. It is 100% free under permissive MIT / Apache-2.0 licenses, requires no subscription or account, and processes all documents locally on the user's hardware.

## Quick Facts
- **Primary Website**: https://photocraft.work/
- **Full LLM Reference**: https://photocraft.work/llms-full.txt
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/bshx2024/photocraft
- **License**: MIT / Apache-2.0 (100% Free & Open Source)
- **Tech Stack**: Pure Rust, WebGPU, WebAssembly (wasm32), wgpu compositor, egui/eframe.

## Core Capabilities
- **1:1 Photoshop Parity**: Identical UI layout, menus, layer styles (Drop Shadow, Stroke, Glow, Bevel), and shortcuts.
- **PSD & PSB Fidelity**: Pixel-accurate PSD/PSB opening, editing, and saving. Verified against 300+ real-world oracle files.
- **WebGPU Hardware Accelerated**: In-browser GPU rendering with zero plugins or installation required.
- **Zero Subscription & 100% Private**: Runs entirely in the client's browser. Files are never uploaded to any server.
- **Agent-Ready Architecture**: Built for AI automation. Over 500 commands accessible via Model Context Protocol (MCP), CLI (`photocraft-cli`), and JSON control socket.
- **Formats Supported**: PSD, PSB, layered TIFF, Paint.NET (PDN), SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, OpenEXR, HDR, and native `.pcraft`.

## Key Comparisons
- **PhotoCraft vs Adobe Photoshop**: PhotoCraft is free forever, has no subscription paywall ($239+/yr saved), runs in any web browser without installation, respects privacy, and provides native MCP integration for AI coding agents.
- **PhotoCraft vs Photopea**: PhotoCraft is 100% open-source and ad-free, written in Rust with WebGPU acceleration (faster than JavaScript Canvas 2D), and offers native offline desktop builds and AI agent automation.
- **PhotoCraft vs GIMP**: PhotoCraft adheres strictly to Photoshop's standard menu taxonomy and keyboard shortcuts, eliminating the steep learning curve of GIMP.
